summary: Update npm CLI and synchronize managed skills/addons; --plan inspects current targets without writes; --release applies an already installed release offline. Repeated --path/--installation scope targets and disable discovery. Filesystem completion does not activate a running game or Agent.
examples: lycheedev update --home EXAMPLE_HOME --release RELEASE_ROOT --path SKILL_DIR --plan --format json
constraints: RELEASE_ROOT is the distribution to synchronize and SKILL_DIR is an existing managed Skill directory. --plan reports the proposed update actions.

summary: Declare a project product: --product <track> [--path <directory>]; creates lycheedev.json without choosing latest
examples: lycheedev project init --path PROJECT_DIR --product retail --format json
constraints: PROJECT_DIR is the directory where lycheedev.json will be created for the selected product.

summary: Inspect independent Hotfix records with an explicit source: --source <wago|dbcache|raidbots>. dbcache reads a pinned --snapshot <pin> (--dbcache <DBCache.bin> | --from <cache-capture>); wago queries the remote record set from --product/--build/--region/--locale with an optional --snapshot parent; raidbots reads --raidbots <DBCache.bin> under 30 days. Filters: --table --table-hash --record --push --status --region-id --search and wago --from/--to; --latest selects the largest matching push batch before pagination; dbcache --scan owns bounded pagination with --max-pages and a resumable --cursor; omitted --snapshot uses --project or the nearest parent project lock; explicit snapshot wins
flags: --scan (dbcache: complete bounded scan; --cursor resumes its capture)
constraints: Remote source flags are validated by the Hotfix provider; see data hotfix --help.
DATA_PIN and DBCACHE_FILE must identify the same product/build. Replace record 2 and table hash 0000002A with the record and hexadecimal table hash to inspect.
examples: lycheedev data hotfix --home EXAMPLE_HOME --source dbcache --snapshot DATA_PIN --dbcache DBCACHE_FILE --table-hash 0000002A --record 2 --format json

summary: Save an existing fixed --snapshot <pin> in lycheedev.lock.json [--path <directory>]; replaces the previous known-format lock
examples: lycheedev project lock --home EXAMPLE_HOME --path PROJECT_DIR --snapshot SOURCE_PIN --format json
constraints: PROJECT_DIR contains lycheedev.json; SOURCE_PIN is an existing fixed selection to write into its lock file.

summary: Read project declaration and lock [--path <directory>]; no workspace or network required
examples: lycheedev project status --path PROJECT_DIR --format json
constraints: PROJECT_DIR contains the project configuration and any current lock file.

summary: Register immutable bounded Lua source under a mutable name without touching the game: --name <name> --file <probe.lua>; returns a content-addressed revision
examples: lycheedev live probe put --home EXAMPLE_HOME --name example_read --file PROBE_FILE --format json
constraints: PROBE_FILE contains Lua source bytes to store under the name example_read.

summary: Execute a bounded probe through durable verified result and runtime release; native CON connections use project journals and stable request keys; --policy controls recovery after runtime loss
examples: lycheedev live execute --home EXAMPLE_HOME --project PROJECT_DIR --session CON_ID --probe example_read --request example-read-001 --budget-seconds 5 --policy observation --format json
constraints: CON_ID is the retained CON- connection in PROJECT_DIR; example_read is a stored probe. A ready connection and fresh compatible INPUT are required. The command sends the observation request identified by --request; retain that identity and deadline for recovery.

summary: List active probe names without game input; --include-removed shows tombstoned names
examples: lycheedev live probe list --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json
constraints: Lists the probe names stored in EXAMPLE_HOME.

summary: Read an exact probe by active name or immutable PRB revision: live probe show <name-or-revision>
examples: lycheedev live probe show example_read --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json
constraints: example_read is a stored probe name; a returned PRB revision can also be used.

summary: Tombstone one probe name for future selection while retaining immutable revisions and operation evidence: live probe remove <name>
examples: lycheedev live probe remove example_read --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json
constraints: example_read is the stored probe name to remove.

summary: Install: --release <distribution-root> --path <parent/lycheedev>; add --output <archive> to upgrade; --resume --path <target> --output <archive> resumes without --release
constraints: --release is required unless --resume is used; --resume requires --output and forbids --release.
RELEASE_ROOT is a valid distribution and SKILL_DIR is the destination directory ending in lycheedev, such as the Agent's user Skill directory.
examples: lycheedev skill install --release RELEASE_ROOT --path SKILL_DIR --format json

summary: Inspect skill ownership and files: --path <installed-directory>
examples: lycheedev skill status --path SKILL_DIR --format json
constraints: SKILL_DIR is the installed Skill directory whose managed files and version will be inspected.

summary: Archive an unchanged owned skill: --path <parent/lycheedev> --output <recovery-directory outside parent>; deletes nothing
examples: lycheedev skill remove --path SKILL_DIR --output SKILL_RECOVERY_DIR --format json
constraints: SKILL_DIR is the managed Skill to remove; SKILL_RECOVERY_DIR is a new directory for its recovery data.

summary: Inspect addon files with --path <addon-directory>, or resolve a supported client with --installation <client-directory>
examples: lycheedev addon status --installation CLIENT_DIR --format json
constraints: CLIENT_DIR selects the installation whose managed addon and slots will be inspected.

summary: Install: --release <distribution-root> --installation <client-directory>; --output <archive> upgrades; --resume --installation <client> --output <archive> recovers without --release
constraints: --release is required unless --resume is used; --resume requires --output and forbids --release.
RELEASE_ROOT is a valid distribution and CLIENT_DIR is the destination client installation. Installation writes the managed addon and its 500 load-on-demand slots.
examples: lycheedev addon install --release RELEASE_ROOT --installation CLIENT_DIR --format json

summary: Archive an unchanged owned addon: --installation <client-directory> --output <recovery-directory>; never deletes SavedVariables
examples: lycheedev addon remove --installation CLIENT_DIR --output ADDON_RECOVERY_DIR --format json
constraints: CLIENT_DIR selects the managed addon and slots to remove; ADDON_RECOVERY_DIR is a new directory for recovery data.

summary: Describe the versioned Agent task protocol and session/result ownership limits; no data pin or worker is opened
examples: lycheedev data agent schema --format json

summary: Run a caller-owned supervised Data Agent worker over stdin/stdout JSONL; typed discovery, queries, result pages, export and release share a pinned session; close or EOF drains submitted work; cancellation or deadline terminates outstanding work and invalidates all handles; no daemon is installed
constraints: --format must be jsonl for the supervised Data Agent worker.

Send stdin as separate JSONL lines: {"protocol":"lycheedev.data-agent.v1","id":1,"task":"query","query":{"kind":"plan","plan":{"op":"scan","table":{"name":"Map","mode":"static"}}}}. Wait for the matching query response, then send {"protocol":"lycheedev.data-agent.v1","id":2,"task":"close"}. If you insert page, capture or other handle operations, assign increasing IDs to every subsequent request, including close.
examples: lycheedev data agent serve --home EXAMPLE_HOME --snapshot DATA_PIN --installation CLIENT_DIR --format jsonl

summary: Materialize one requested static table as a bounded, authenticated Data generation; omitted --snapshot uses --project or the nearest parent project lock; explicit snapshot wins
examples: lycheedev data cache prepare Map --home EXAMPLE_HOME --snapshot DATA_PIN --installation CLIENT_DIR --format json
constraints: DATA_PIN fixes the product/build/locale selection; CLIENT_DIR supplies matching installation data. Map is the table to prepare. Preparation loads its required definitions and data into the cache; --offline requires all needed inputs already cached.

summary: Verify CASC file: --snapshot <pin> (--installation <client-or-game-root> | --cdn) --file-id <id> [--max-bytes <n>] [--offline] [--content-variant standard|low-violence]; archive original bytes; omitted --snapshot uses --project or the nearest parent project lock; explicit snapshot wins
examples: lycheedev asset inspect --home EXAMPLE_HOME --snapshot DATA_PIN --installation CLIENT_DIR --file-id 134400 --format json
constraints: DATA_PIN fixes the product/build/locale selection; CLIENT_DIR supplies matching installation data. Replace 134400 with the FileDataID to inspect.

summary: Use one listfile mode: --query <text>, --extension <ext>, --name <path>, or --file-id <id>; requires --snapshot and --listfile <community-csv|wowexport-text|wowexport-binary>; --limit bounds search and extension pages; --offline reuses verified cache; --max-bytes bounds total listfile input (default 256 MiB, maximum 512 MiB); omitted --snapshot uses --project or the nearest parent project lock; explicit snapshot wins
constraints: Exactly one listfile source mode is required.
--listfile community-csv selects that public listfile source. --offline requires its authenticated cache already prepared in EXAMPLE_HOME; BLP is the search term.
examples: lycheedev asset search --home EXAMPLE_HOME --snapshot DATA_PIN --listfile community-csv --query BLP --limit 1 --offline --format json

summary: Export CASC file: --snapshot <pin> (--installation <client-or-game-root> | --cdn) --file-id <id> --output <file> [--encoding raw|png|webp] [--mipmap <0..15>] [--channels <rgba-subset>] [--max-pixels <n>] [--overwrite] [--max-bytes <n>] [--offline] [--content-variant standard|low-violence]; raw default, BLP2 image conversion, existing parent required; omitted --snapshot uses --project or the nearest parent project lock; explicit snapshot wins
examples: lycheedev asset export --home EXAMPLE_HOME --snapshot DATA_PIN --installation CLIENT_DIR --file-id 134400 --encoding raw --output RAW_OUTPUT_FILE --format json
constraints: DATA_PIN fixes the product/build/locale selection; CLIENT_DIR supplies matching installation data for file 134400. RAW_OUTPUT_FILE is a new output file under an existing parent directory; --encoding raw exports the original bytes.

summary: Demux a bounded VP9 AVI from --path <local-file> or pinned CASC (--snapshot <pin> and --file-id <id> with --installation or --cdn); --output <existing-directory> [--max-bytes <n>] [--max-frames <n>] [--allow-partial] [--overwrite]; omitted --snapshot uses --project or the nearest parent project lock; explicit snapshot wins
examples: lycheedev asset demux --home EXAMPLE_HOME --path AVI_FILE --output FRAMES_DIR --format json
constraints: AVI_FILE is a complete supported local AVI input; FRAMES_DIR is an existing output directory. The command writes extracted frames and their manifest there.

summary: Inspect the native toolkit build
examples: lycheedev version --format json

summary: Read implemented command contracts
examples: lycheedev describe --format json

summary: Create a new-format workspace without importing old data; --plan resolves the fresh-isolation plan without changing anything, --fresh isolates an occupied legacy root into a deterministic sibling archive first, --resume completes an interrupted archive switch
constraints: At most one of --plan, --fresh or --resume.
EXAMPLE_HOME is the workspace directory to initialize.
examples: lycheedev init --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json

summary: Diagnose workspace, data, embedded Emmy worker smoke, source and a selected live target or original CON; read-only by default; --fix repairs managed installation and recovers the original connection; --fix --hard-reset archives and initializes all 500 slots; exit 3 means an unhealthy check
examples: lycheedev doctor --home EXAMPLE_HOME --offline --format json
constraints: Inspects the workspace and installed local providers/runtimes, reporting their availability and any required corrections.
Select --installation/--pid, or --session CON_ID with its original --project; these target forms cannot be combined.
--hard-reset, --release, --output and --request require --fix. A repair requires a selected target or original CON.
--fix --hard-reset archives the original slot manifest and fixed 500 slot paths before initializing the pool; retained CON input and reports follow their original recovery state.

summary: Read the workspace user preference and resource budget document; a missing document reports the documented defaults
examples: lycheedev config show --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json
constraints: Reads the configuration of EXAMPLE_HOME.

summary: Update the workspace budget: --cache-max-bytes <n> and/or --download-workers <n>; at least one flag is required
examples: lycheedev config set --home EXAMPLE_HOME --download-workers 1 --format json
constraints: Sets the workspace download-worker count to 1.

summary: Report managed cache accounting, protection visibility and the configured limit
examples: lycheedev cache status --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json
constraints: Reports cache usage in EXAMPLE_HOME; --data selects the Data usage view.

summary: Verify every managed cache object against its content hash; strictly read-only, repairs and deletes nothing
examples: lycheedev cache verify --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json
constraints: Checks the cache entries and content hashes in EXAMPLE_HOME.

summary: Reclaim ordinary cache toward --target-bytes <n> (zero reclaims all ordinary cache), capped by --max-objects <n>; --uncommitted also reclaims staging files; --dry-run reports without deleting; protected and in-use objects are always skipped; --data-derived selects rebuildable Data objects and generations only (not downloads, shared blobs or CAP), with a remaining-byte target and distinct object-group attempt cap; staging cannot be combined
examples: lycheedev cache prune --home EXAMPLE_HOME --target-bytes 0 --dry-run --format json
constraints: --dry-run reports which cache objects are eligible for removal toward --target-bytes in EXAMPLE_HOME.

summary: List supported installations and running windows without game input or actor claims; use live connect for fresh native identity binding
examples: lycheedev live instances --home EXAMPLE_HOME --installation CLIENT_DIR --format json
constraints: CLIENT_DIR filters passive process discovery to the selected installation.

summary: Discover and freshly bind a native memory/500-slot connection in the invoking project; optional snapshot constrains build; --session CON-id resumes retained work
examples: lycheedev live connect --home EXAMPLE_HOME --project PROJECT_DIR --installation CLIENT_DIR --pid 12345 --format json
constraints: Replace 12345 with the selected process PID from live instances and use its matching CLIENT_DIR. Retain the returned CON connection ID in PROJECT_DIR.

summary: Perform one correlated UI reload on the selected client and verify the new runtime: --session <session-id> --request <idempotency-key>
examples: lycheedev live reload --home EXAMPLE_HOME --project PROJECT_DIR --session CON_ID --request example-reload-001 --format json
constraints: CON_ID is the ready connection in PROJECT_DIR. This sends a reload request to its client; keep the original request identity and deadline for recovery.

summary: Activate a clean managed addon and its 500 slots on an explicit installation/PID using fresh Mailbox readiness for a recorded reload, or waiting for one manual reload when no current input protocol is loaded, then verify a new runtime and fresh connection; --request is idempotent
examples: lycheedev live reload fallback --home EXAMPLE_HOME --project PROJECT_DIR --installation CLIENT_DIR --pid 12345 --request example-activate-001 --format json
constraints: CLIENT_DIR and the selected PID identify the client to activate through its fresh compatible INPUT and effective binding. Retain any returned CON connection for recovery.

summary: Read 1-100 retained provider errors; native CON connections persist and release the bounded observation result automatically
examples: lycheedev live bugs --home EXAMPLE_HOME --project PROJECT_DIR --session CON_ID --request example-bugs-001 --count 1 --format json
constraints: CON_ID is the ready connection in PROJECT_DIR. Sends a diagnostic observation request for up to 1 recent error entry.

summary: Pin data identity from --target <name>, --installation <game-root-or-client> optionally constrained by --product <track>, remote --product <track> without installation, or --file <selection.json>; local selection never falls back to remote; named targets resolve their exact configured identity at command start
examples: lycheedev target resolve --home EXAMPLE_HOME --installation CLIENT_DIR --product retail --build 12.1.5.70448 --definitions DBD_COMMIT --region us --locale enUS --offline --format json
constraints: CLIENT_DIR must match retail/build 12.1.5.70448; DBD_COMMIT is the fixed definitions commit for that build. --offline requires needed inputs already recorded or present. Retain the returned DATA_PIN.

--from fills missing fixed selections and preserves existing Source/Data/Changes unchanged. To select another Data identity, omit --from or use a parent that contains Source but no Data; changing inherited Data returns selection.fixed_data_conflict.
--file publishes a new fixed selection and rejects retired Forever beta product IDs, including inherited components. Existing historical PINs remain readable through target show.

summary: Read a named target configuration and its references, or an explicit PIN- selection ID
examples: lycheedev target show DATA_PIN --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json
constraints: DATA_PIN is an existing PIN- selection ID; a stored target name is also accepted.

summary: List every named target configuration in name order; a brand new workspace has no targets
examples: lycheedev target list --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json
constraints: Lists the target names configured in EXAMPLE_HOME.

summary: Create or explicitly replace one named target: target add <name> --product <track> --region <region> --locale <locale> with exactly one of --installation <client> or --remote; optional --build <full-build> pins that exact release; --replace confirms replacement
constraints: Exactly one of --installation or --remote is required.
example-retail is the target name to create for CLIENT_DIR, product retail, region us and locale enUS.
examples: lycheedev target add example-retail --home EXAMPLE_HOME --installation CLIENT_DIR --product retail --region us --locale enUS --format json

summary: Remove one named target and its reference ledger: target remove <name>; resolved pins stay intact, running operations block removal
examples: lycheedev target remove example-retail --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json
constraints: example-retail is the target name to remove. Existing project or operation references must be released first.

summary: List the releases the version manifests serve for one region: --region <region>; one bounded manifest fetch per supported product with per-product failures reported inline; --offline is refused because the listing is inherently current
examples: lycheedev target available --region us --format json
constraints: Retrieves current online product manifests for region us; network access is required.

summary: Read the persisted CON connection, request and cleanup state without opening the game or sending input: live status <CON-id>
examples: lycheedev live status CON_ID --home EXAMPLE_HOME --project PROJECT_DIR --format json
constraints: Use the retained CON- connection ID from the original PROJECT_DIR.

summary: Recover the original Native CON connection and request; revalidate identity and never repeat unknown input
examples: lycheedev live resume CON_ID --home EXAMPLE_HOME --project PROJECT_DIR --format json
constraints: CON_ID and PROJECT_DIR identify the original connection, request and deadline to recover. Submitted or uncertain input retains its original recovery state.

summary: Verify a retained session and its evidence: live session <session-id>; does not reconnect or authorize input
examples: lycheedev live session CON_ID --home EXAMPLE_HOME --project PROJECT_DIR --format json
constraints: Inspects the retained CON- connection in PROJECT_DIR.

summary: Unbind a quiescent memory/slot connection and release its durable host ownership; repeat safely after interruption
examples: lycheedev live disconnect CON_ID --project PROJECT_DIR --format json
constraints: CON_ID selects the connection to disconnect in its original PROJECT_DIR. The result reports connection cleanup state.

summary: Read a capture manifest: evidence show <capture-id>
examples: lycheedev evidence show CAP_ID --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json
constraints: CAP_ID is an existing CAP- capture ID in EXAMPLE_HOME.

summary: Verify manifest and original bytes: evidence verify <capture-id>
examples: lycheedev evidence verify CAP_ID --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json
constraints: CAP_ID selects a capture whose manifest, content-addressed blob and dependencies will be checked.

summary: List archived capture manifests in ID order with a bounded page
examples: lycheedev evidence list --home EXAMPLE_HOME --limit 1 --format json
constraints: Lists up to 1 capture from EXAMPLE_HOME.

summary: Write a complete ZIP of 1..100 verified captures: --ids <CAP-a,CAP-b> --output <new-file>; refuses existing output and caps unique payload bytes at 128 MiB
examples: lycheedev evidence bundle --ids CAP_ID --output BUNDLE_OUTPUT_FILE --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json
constraints: CAP_ID selects a capture and its dependency closure; BUNDLE_OUTPUT_FILE is a new output file for the bundle.

summary: Record an explicit retention decision for one capture; repeated calls are idempotent: evidence keep <capture-id>
examples: lycheedev evidence keep CAP_ID --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json
constraints: Marks CAP_ID as retained so cache pruning preserves its capture dependencies.

summary: Explicitly remove one unreferenced capture manifest and its unshared blob: evidence remove <capture-id>; never follows cache pruning or deletes a shared blob
examples: lycheedev evidence remove CAP_ID --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json
constraints: CAP_ID is the CAP- capture ID to remove. It must be unkept and free of active references.

summary: List source repositories and product branches; --snapshot <pin> reports fixed file-mapping readiness; omitted --snapshot uses --project or the nearest parent project lock; explicit snapshot wins
examples: lycheedev source list --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json
constraints: Lists the configured source catalog and readiness of prepared snapshots.

summary: Run 1-32 query/refs/context requests from a JSON file against one fixed snapshot, sharing preparation and a request-scoped native Emmy session; each item retains its own cursor and coverage; omitted --snapshot uses --project or the nearest parent project lock; explicit snapshot wins
examples: lycheedev source batch --home EXAMPLE_HOME --snapshot SOURCE_PIN --file BATCH_FILE --format json
constraints: BATCH_FILE contains a JSON request object, for example {"requests":[{"id":"query-1","query":{"text":"GetActionButtonForID","topic":"lua","mode":"precise","limit":1}}]}. SOURCE_PIN selects the fixed snapshot for every item.

summary: Fetch --source <key> --product <track> [--ref <full-ref-or-commit>] and return a fixed snapshot
examples: lycheedev source sync --home EXAMPLE_HOME --source wow-ui-source --product retail --ref 31c7f7b9cc79e56c986b365c06a6afbcf3c9177b --format json
constraints: The full commit identifies the Retail source revision to prepare. An absent revision is fetched from the configured source remote. Retain the returned SOURCE_PIN.

summary: Inspect one fixed source: --path <file> for original lines, --symbol <qualified-name> for symbol candidates, or --target-path <path> for file/asset facts; omitted --snapshot uses --project or the nearest parent project lock; explicit snapshot wins
examples: lycheedev source inspect --home EXAMPLE_HOME --snapshot SOURCE_PIN --path Interface/AddOns/Blizzard_ActionBar/Shared/ActionButton.lua --line 97 --count 1 --format json
constraints: SOURCE_PIN is the Retail snapshot from source sync at the shown commit; the path and line identify the source range to read.

summary: Explicitly warm the rebuildable file mapping for --snapshot <pin-id>, retaining parse diagnostics; omitted --snapshot uses --project or the nearest parent project lock; explicit snapshot wins
examples: lycheedev source index --home EXAMPLE_HOME --snapshot SOURCE_PIN --format json
constraints: SOURCE_PIN is the fixed Source PIN from source sync in EXAMPLE_HOME, with its source mirror prepared.

summary: Prepare and search the exact pinned source mapping by topic and evidence tier with bounded, resumable pages; omitted --snapshot uses --project or the nearest parent project lock; explicit snapshot wins
examples: lycheedev source query GetActionButtonForID --home EXAMPLE_HOME --snapshot SOURCE_PIN --topic lua --mode precise --limit 1 --format json
constraints: SOURCE_PIN selects the fixed Retail snapshot. GetActionButtonForID is the positional query term.

summary: Find bounded relations for one pinned symbol ID (or an unambiguous symbol name); retain relation state, coverage and next cursor; omitted --snapshot uses --project or the nearest parent project lock; explicit snapshot wins
examples: lycheedev source refs --home EXAMPLE_HOME --snapshot SOURCE_PIN --symbol GetActionButtonForID --direction incoming --limit 1 --release RELEASE_ROOT --format json
constraints: SOURCE_PIN selects the fixed source snapshot; RELEASE_ROOT supplies the native runtime. A matching --environment client PIN supplies client API facts, and the result reports the available coverage.

summary: Read bounded source context for one pinned symbol ID (or an unambiguous name), with direct relations and load evidence; --flow requests bounded secret-value analysis; omitted --snapshot uses --project or the nearest parent project lock; explicit snapshot wins
examples: lycheedev source context --home EXAMPLE_HOME --snapshot SOURCE_PIN --symbol GetActionButtonForID --depth 0 --limit 1 --release RELEASE_ROOT --format json
constraints: SOURCE_PIN selects the fixed source snapshot; RELEASE_ROOT supplies the native runtime. A matching --environment client PIN supplies client API facts for the reported context.

summary: Inspect the opt-in native Source session for this home without starting it
examples: lycheedev source session status --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json
constraints: Reports the retained native session in EXAMPLE_HOME. refs/context --session-reuse creates or reuses that session.

summary: Retire the verified opt-in native Source session and release its worktree lease
examples: lycheedev source session close --home EXAMPLE_HOME --format json
constraints: Closes the retained native Source session in EXAMPLE_HOME.

summary: Compare --from <pin-id> --to <pin-id> [--limit <n> per change category]
examples: lycheedev source diff --home EXAMPLE_HOME --from SOURCE_PIN --to SOURCE_PIN --format json
constraints: SOURCE_PIN is an existing fixed selection. Using the same pin for --from and --to produces an empty comparison; use two fixed pins to inspect revision changes.

summary: Explicitly reclaim only unused source worktrees toward --target-bytes <n>; fixed Git pins, facts and captures remain
examples: lycheedev source prune --home EXAMPLE_HOME --target-bytes 0 --format json
constraints: Removes eligible derived source cache from EXAMPLE_HOME toward --target-bytes, accounting for fixed-pin, project, capture and active-session references.

summary: Validate one pinned addon closure with --path/--toc/--snapshot, or a fixed multi-client --matrix <config.json>; add --semantic for native Emmy analysis using fixed client API metadata; report unresolved coverage; omitted --snapshot uses --project or the nearest parent project lock; explicit snapshot wins
examples: lycheedev source validate --home EXAMPLE_HOME --snapshot SOURCE_PIN --path ADDON_DIR --toc Main.toc --release RELEASE_ROOT --format json
constraints: ADDON_DIR is the addon to validate and Main.toc is its relative manifest listing Lua/XML loads. RELEASE_ROOT supplies the managed Lua 5.1 compiler for closure and syntax checks.

summary: Search local command capabilities by task; returns at most five ranked commands without opening a workspace, cache, worker or network.
examples: lycheedev cli search "spell"

summary: Inspect the exact CLI input contract for a command path. Data Agent commands include the authoritative typed session protocol; no worker or engine is started.
examples: lycheedev schema data agent serve --format json
